no-restricted-syntax.message: pollingInterval caused the June 2026 Vercel usage bloat: polling an /api/* route bills a function invocation + provisioned-memory wall-clock time per tick, per open tab, around the clock. Poll ONLY endpoints whose queryFn calls Supabase directly (rpc/select — zero Vercel compute), never a fetchBaseQuery '/api' route. Pair with skipPollingIfUnfocused. If the target is Supabase-direct, add an eslint-disable comment stating so.
